dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you not like the city?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: What's so great about the city? Its atmosphere always feels weird to me.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: No matter how tall the buildings that are built leaning against the Divine Tree are, we seem to draw no closer to the gods.

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Otherwise, why would researchers who so desperately yearn for knowledge come to Avidya Forest to gain success?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...Not that I'm saying that knowledge is that good, but you should understand what I mean, right?
